name: Dancehall chat cuts
desc: Deejay chat in the toasting tradition: male TTS shouts (pressure, underground, thunder, selecta, voltage) dropped on the off-positions, pitched slightly down, with dub delay throws every fourth bar. Peak chops the words into double-time stutters like a selector working the fader.

code.full: s("<[~ pressure ~ ~] [~ ~ underground ~] [~ thunder ~ ~] [~ ~ selecta ~]>").speed("<.9 .95 .85 .92>").shape(.4).hpf(180).lpf(3800).gain(${gain}).room(.25).delay(${wet}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.5).lastOf(4, x=>x.delayfeedback(.72)).orbit(8).play()
code.peak: s("<[~ pressure ~ pressure] [~ ~ underground ~] [voltage ~ thunder ~] [~ selecta ~ selecta]>").speed("<.9 .95 .85 1>").chop(2).ply("<1 2 1 1>").shape(.45).hpf(200).lpf(4200).gain(${gain}).room(.25).delay(${wet}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.55).lastOf(4, x=>x.delayfeedback(.75)).orbit(8).play()
